feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 28 November 2026 4:15am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Saturday, 28 November 2026 at 4:15am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure near Iceland bringing a frontal zone across the Irish Sea today.


##Wind##

Southeast 5 to 7, veering west or southwest 4 to 6 late afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, building mainly moderate in the morning, occasionally touching rough in the northeast for a time in the afternoon.


##Weather##

Risk of mist in the east at first. Rain arriving late morning until early evening.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, occasionally poor in rain or mist.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Southwest 4 to 6, increasing 5 to 7 for a time Sunday morning. Increasing south-southwest 6 to gale 8 later on Sunday night.


##State of Sea##

Mainly moderate, occasionally rough on Sunday morning. Then becoming rough later on Sunday night.


##Weather##

Showers for a time Sunday morning, then rain later on Sunday night.


##Visibility##

Mostly good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain later.
